summary: The note profiles eight local inventors who unveiled technologies between September and December 2023, spanning EV power inverters, augmented reality, vertical hydroponic farming, mesh networks, air-pollution scrubbers, haptic gloves, graphene production and multispectral solar panels. Each innovation is described with its core technical idea and potential impact across industries. The piece frames them as emerging trailblazers addressing real-world challenges.
one_line: Profiles eight local inventors whose late-2023 breakthroughs span EVs, AR, urban farming, mesh networks, air purification, haptics, graphene and solar power.
key_facts: Marcus Green developed an ultra-efficient power inverter for electric vehicles, announced October 12, 2023.
Green's inverter operates at 99% efficiency versus the industry standard of 90-95%, extending EV range.
Sofia Nguyen unveiled an augmented reality platform on September 9, 2023 that needs no bulky headsets or special glasses and projects 3D images through a small, portable device.
Nguyen's AR device uses machine learning to map physical space in real time and identify objects, surfaces and people's movement.
Rajeev Chowdhury introduced the "Green Spire" project on November 5, 2023, a vertical-tower hydroponic system with a closed-loop water system that recycles nutrient-rich water.
The Green Spire grows crops year-round without chemical pesticides or fertilizers and enables high-density planting.
Jasmine Harris brought forth a decentralized mesh network on October 15, 2023 whose interconnected nodes route data and self-heal if one node goes down.
Humanitarian organizations have shown interest in implementing Harris's mesh networks in underdeveloped regions and disaster relief.

Laura Diaz presented a prototype HEPA scrubber on September 28, 2023 that captures pollutants at the nano-level, uses less energy than similar systems, and can be integrated into public transportation and streetlights.
Theo Vasquez unveiled a haptic feedback glove on December 1, 2023 using miniature actuators to simulate vibrations, resistance and temperature changes in virtual reality.
Dr. Aisha Patel's team announced a cost-effective method to mass-produce graphene on November 20, 2023, using chemical vapor deposition on copper foil substrate.
Alex Johnson announced a new multilayered solar panel on September 18, 2023 that captures visible, ultraviolet and infrared light and performs well in cloudy weather or indirect sunlight.
